name: CICS-04S: Higher-dimensional CPU capacity and numerical failure-boundary benchmark (through 384D)
description: Results-only numerical benchmark of the unmodified archived CICS-04S regular-simplex implementation beyond 9D. Completed sampled targets through 384D pass the original geometry, scale-signature and recursive-recovery gates and independent reference checks. This is a sampled sweep, not every intervening integer dimension. Recorded numerical failures are retained: scale-4 determinant intermediate overflow at 254D and scale-0.25 underflow to zero at 272D, despite passing geometry gates. A single 384D campaign completed in 13.817 seconds; the 512D probe exceeded its declared 20-second worker budget without a completed geometry result. The deposit contains measurements, raw results, reference arrays, figures, methods, hashes and limitations. These three-dimension campaigns differ from the earlier cumulative 1–9D workload, so timings are not directly comparable. No finite mathematical dimensional ceiling or physical extra dimensions are established. Related public reference: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23286174. Files are restricted; no additional reuse permission is granted. Private ICS Research Studio source is excluded. Status: supported computational benchmark; upper capacity beyond the probes remains unconfirmed.
